data.name: Find
data.value: SELECT snapshot_json, request_hash FROM user_context_revisions WHERE user_id = @userId AND company_id = @companyId AND revision_id = @revisionId

data.name: Latest
data.value: SELECT snapshot_json, request_hash FROM user_context_revisions WHERE user_id = @userId AND company_id = @companyId AND known_at_ticks <= @asOfTicks ORDER BY known_at_ticks DESC LIMIT 1

data.name: LockUser
data.value: SELECT id FROM users WHERE id = @userId FOR UPDATE

data.name: LastTime
data.value: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(known_at_ticks), 0) FROM user_context_revisions WHERE user_id = @userId

data.name: Insert
data.value: INSERT INTO user_context_revisions (user_id, company_id, revision_id, known_at_ticks, snapshot_json, request_hash) VALUES (@userId, @companyId, @revisionId, @knownAtTicks, @snapshotJson, @requestHash) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING revision_id

data.name: UpdateUser
data.value: UPDATE users SET source_person_id = @sourcePersonId, city_name = @cityName, rc_name = @rcName WHERE id = @userId
